brief: A modern, friendly identity for documentation authored as Markdown. The approved Page space lettering stays intact; blurple becomes the primary colour.
criteria: Full wordmark from 96 px; compact m at 16 px. Original vector lettering, black/white variants, portable assets.

concepts.name: Page space
concepts.idea: Rounded document windows inside a friendly, lowercase mdd.
rationale: Original approved letters without gesture additions.
Blurple #5865F2 is the user-selected primary colour.
The first letter supplies a compact m for tabs and icons.

recommendation: Use the complete wordmark for introductions. Context mockups are illustrative, not screenshots of implemented features or live deployments.
next_steps: Use the supplied artwork and usage guide.
Proof physical reproductions with your printer.
